name: Lebanon

findings.local_actor: Mobile Interim Company No.2 (touch), state-owned mobile operator
findings.summary: touch awarded Huawei two direct-agreement contracts (equipment US$8.34m, services US$1.39m), signed July 2025 and running to August 2026, for end-of-support network upgrades covering carrier aggregation, microwave and packet core.
findings.analyst_inference: verified_value_usd is the sum of the two USD award amounts on the PPA award notice (8,336,441 + 1,393,935); the page's Arabic amount-in-words for lot 2 appears garbled, numeric figure used. Packet-core scope suggests Huawei supplies at least part of touch's core, not just RAN. Single opened S1 source, so medium. Tender titled 'Phase 1.2', implying earlier Huawei phases not reviewed.

findings.local_actor: touch (MIC2) and Alfa (MIC1); Ministry of Telecommunications
findings.summary: Lebanon began a 150-station, three-year 5G rollout split between touch and Alfa; touch uses Huawei and Nokia technology, while Alfa's vendor is not named. Alfa 5G already live in parts of Beirut.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole null because touch's 5G mixes a PRC (Huawei) and a Nordic (Nokia) vendor with no stated split, and Alfa's 5G vendor is unnamed. Tier 4 as rollout under way with live sites; not yet at scale. US$1m is an unnamed ministry source's total project cost, implausibly low for 150 sites; treat with caution. Article meta description says August 2025, body says 2026.

findings.summary: Alfa signed 4.5G LTE-Advanced deployment contracts with Ericsson and Nokia to re-equip about 1,300 radio sites nationwide, plus separate 5G-preparation MOUs with each vendor.
findings.analyst_inference: Pre-2020: still_current null because no opened source confirms Ericsson/Nokia remain Alfa's RAN vendors in 2026; Alfa's June 2025 statement on an 80% network modernisation names no vendor. Core-network vendor not stated.

findings.summary: Alfa signed a deployment agreement for Nokia AirScale single-RAN equipment for 3G and LTE-Advanced Pro, with VoLTE and 2G spectrum refarming, plus an MOU on evolution toward 5G.
findings.analyst_inference: Vendor release is S1 for the fact of the agreement but self-interested; single opened source, so medium. Pre-2020, current status unconfirmed; value and site count not disclosed.

findings.local_actor: Council of Ministers; Starlink Lebanon (local company); Telecommunications Regulatory Authority
findings.summary: Lebanon's cabinet licensed Starlink Lebanon to provide satellite internet, initially for businesses, over lobbying by state providers; scope widened in March 2026, but the regulator said in mid-2026 service had not commercially launched.
findings.analyst_inference: Tier 4 as licence issued; not tier 5 because no commercial launch as of mid-2026 per SMEX (advocacy NGO, coded S4). New Arab relays Lebanon's state agency NNA (not PRC media). Only one opened S1-S3 source, so low.

findings.controller: Ministry of Telecommunications (operator not stated; touch on site)
findings.summary: The telecom ministry is converting a Dekwaneh warehouse into a national data centre, merging the existing Karantina and Sawwar facilities; rehabilitation and equipment installation were under way in April 2026.
findings.analyst_inference: Owner-operator is Lebanese state, so domestic; equipment vendors, builder and financier not named. Tier 4 as works under way. Single opened S2 source, so low. Alfa separately reported its own new data centre completed in June 2025 (not coded; vendor unknown).

silicon.null_reason: no dedicated search; no accelerator purchases surfaced in facilities/AI searches, and Lebanon is in D:5 (presumption of denial) per global layer

models.null_reason: one AI-partnership search found Microsoft (Dec 2025) and Oracle (Dec 2025 MOU) AI-training/startup agreements and a Roland Berger strategy MOU, but no model-provider deployment or national model

applications.null_reason: one search found no Huawei/Hikvision safe-city or surveillance deployment in Lebanon

research_gaps: Who supplies Alfa's RAN and core today (2025 three-year 80% modernisation and 5G)? Ericsson/Nokia status since 2018 unconfirmed.
Earlier phases of touch's Huawei 'EOS Network Upgrades' and whether Huawei supplies touch's full packet core; check further PPA notices.
Ogero backbone/FTTx vendor (Huawei vs others) not established; fiber-optic project lead (fiberconnectmena) not opened.
Should the Dec 2025 Oracle MOU (training 50,000 in AI/ERP, US embassy attended) and Microsoft agreement be coded as tier-1 US application/models signals? Left uncoded as training, not deployment.
OMSAR Sept 2026 cloud-policy EOI and World Bank-backed US$285m IT modernisation: which cloud/hosting vendors?
Hosting stack and vendor for the new Dekwaneh national data centre and Alfa's data centre.
